title: Grandma saved one every winter… 🥺
description:
When I was little, Grandma saved the ripest persimmon for me.
Every winter since, she kept one… just in case.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#Grandma #Korea #Hanok #Persimmon #Family #shorts
pinned: What did YOUR grandma always save for you? 🥺 Tell Kachi 💛
